run_id.description: run_id of the evidence bundle this decision was made against

repository.description: Remote origin URL — part of the history-match key

file_path.description: Repo-relative path to the file containing the changed function — part of the history-match key

symbol.description: Fully-qualified dotted name of the changed function — part of the history-match key

probe_file.description: Repo-relative path to the probe file

probe_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the probe file bytes — links this decision to a specific, unchanged probe

case_id.description: Stable case ID within the probe file this decision covers

observed_before.description: Captured output from the base revision — any JSON value including exception records

observed_after.description: Captured output from the head revision — any JSON value including exception records

rationale.description: Must be non-empty when verdict is intended

status.description: Always written as proposed; approved status is derived from presence on the default branch
